# 09_relist_if_manifest_changed.sh - Re-list files after the manifest changed

## Description

Re-runs [03_list_data_files.sh](#help-03_list_data_files) and [04_list_program_files.sh](#help-04_list_program_files) when `generated/manifest[.tag].txt` has uncommitted changes, so the data and program lists match a manifest that was edited by hand or refreshed. When the manifest is missing or unchanged, it does nothing.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/09_relist_if_manifest_changed.sh <directory> [tag] [zipfile]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory.
- `tag` - Optional suffix of the manifest and the lists.
- `zipfile` - Passed through to the listing scripts.

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
